fixture.placement: network.at(edge.offset + 1940), heading atan2(p.tx,p.tz), layer p.y + 0.5; settle with normal session physics
fixture.steering: RouteDriver(skill=1), RoutePath edge quarry#0 from 1900 to 2200, relocate(40)
fixture.pedals: after driver.update each tick: setInput({...car.input, throttle:0.3, brake:0})

interpretation.recordOrigin: Exact JSON measurement output retained from the executed program; metadata added afterward.
interpretation.i: Zero-based tick index after the 120 settling ticks and initial rolling setup.
interpretation.initialSpeed: Controlled initial tangential speed in m/s, not the speed at takeoff.
interpretation.longestAir: Longest continuous interval with no tire carrying more than 20 N.
interpretation.peakClearance: Body centre height above the sampled road/ground, not a rendered tire clearance.
interpretation.airDistance: Horizontal displacement from the last supported body position to first landing contact.
interpretation.offRoad: Count of measured ticks outside the road footprint.
interpretation.skills: Provisional feedback has zero points; only the stable landing adds unbanked driving points. No career reward is claimed.
interpretation.limitations: Automated fixture on one natural crest and one vehicle; no human driving, browser, visual-quality or hardware-performance claim.
